ai_summary: Ador Welding Limited reported robust financial performance for the half-year ended September 30, 2026, with revenue increasing by approximately 23% and net profit surging by 143% year-over-year, significantly aided by the absence of prior-period one-time onerous costs. The company also declared an interim dividend of Rs. 7.50 per share; however, a material red flag is the substantial negative operating cash flow of INR 1,760 lakhs, which was primarily financed by a significant increase in current borrowings and a drastic reduction in cash reserves, raising concerns about short-term liquidity despite strong reported profits.
